title: 067. Subsets
prompt: Given an integer array `nums` of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set).
invariant: At index i: branch 1 includes nums[i], branch 2 skips nums[i]
firstLine: Create `res = []`, `path = []`, and write `dfs(i)` branching on include vs skip.
steps: In `dfs(i)`: if `i == len(nums)`, append `path[:]` to `res` and return
pythonOutlineComments:
# Step 1: Initialize `res = []` and `path = []`
# Step 2: In `dfs(i)`: if `i == len(nums)`, append `path[:]` to `res` and return
# Step 3: Append `nums[i]`, call `dfs(i + 1)`, pop `path.pop()`, then call `dfs(i + 1)`

hints.title: First-Line Nudge
hints.content: Create `res = []`, `path = []`, and write `dfs(i)` branching on include vs skip.

hints.title: Pattern & Invariant
hints.content: Core invariant: `At index i: branch 1 includes nums[i], branch 2 skips nums[i]`

hints.title: Step-by-Step Plan
hints.content: Step 1: Initialize `res = []` and `path = []` -> Step 2: In `dfs(i)`: if `i == len(nums)`, append `path[:]` to `res` and return -> Step 3: Append `nums[i]`, call `dfs(i + 1)`, pop `path.pop()`, then call `dfs(i + 1)`

hints.title: Complexity & Edge Cases
hints.content: Aim for O(N * 2^N) time and O(N) space. Watch empty inputs, single elements, and duplicates.
